zh: 优化 Android CI 构建流程，自动生成与配置发布签名密钥，确保 APK 流水线开箱即用稳定出包。
移动端界面深度打磨：新增 AI 思考状态脉冲动效与自动吸底，优化抽屉滑动手势与模式切换交互体验。
完善内置工具使用指引文档，并增强桌面智能体对新版 Claude Desktop 会话标题与无障碍树的适配兼容。
en: Streamline Android CI build workflow with automatic release keystore generation for reliable headless APK packaging.
Refine mobile shell UX: add pulsing AI thinking status bubble with auto-scroll anchor, and improve drawer gesture handling between chat and tools.
Enhance builtin tool guides and improve desktop agent accessibility tree parsing for newer Claude Desktop session headers.
